Each bundle key lists what its porter and integrator handed on, and each handed_on item carries the release note of 2026-11-06. The plan is in createaddition-backport-inventory.json, the docs in okf/modpack/createaddition-backport.md.

deferred: Live world copy: on a copy of the live world with every dimension (Mac mini), run tools/wire_scan.py <world> --json before.json with 1.3.3 still in place. Count the one sided wire ends of that scan before the deploy, because the first graph check of the fork cuts them without a drop.

Boot the copy with the release jar and skytekx-compat 2.1.6 on the production Arclight jar. Run cca_wires stats and cca_wires verify in every dimension that holds wires (execute in for all but the Overworld). The boot must keep the boot baseline.

Run Chunky with radius 500 around the largest wire network of the copy and check that the flow holds and that the log stays clean, since WireGraphVerifier reads unloaded chunks through chunkMap.read and IOWorker.loadAsync while Chunky queues its own chunk IO.
Toggle a redstone relay while its chunk and the chunks around it are unloaded: unpowered no energy crosses it, powered again the flow resumes.

Restart the copy, run cca_wires verify again, stop it and run tools/wire_scan.py <world> --compare before.json. Pass: 0 differences (0 differ, 0 gone) in every dimension. Nodes not yet discovered by the graph and unchecked vertices are no fault. The compare list must hold only the one sided wire ends of the first scan.

Repeat the boot, the verify and the scan with skytekx-compat 2.1.3. Both versions must give the same graph, since 2.1.6 hands out a copy of the queued tag and 2.1.3 does not (okf/server/logs-and-crashes.md).

Round trip: boot the copy once with 1.3.3 after the fork boot, break a connector there, then boot the fork again. The verifier must drop the stale vertex at load (7eb20d9), and the 11 new config keys come back with their defaults.

Node0..node7 format: reading wire nodes in the old format through WireVertex.fromBlockEntityTag was not tested, because a loaded block entity converts them at once. If the live world copy holds any (wire_scan.py counts them), check that they match after the upgrade.
Keep the status cell of the connector rework on okf/modpack/createaddition-backport.md at 'Ported, live world test open' until every step above has passed.

Render culling, on a pack client with Embeddium, Oculus and EntityCulling: a 32 block wire whose connector is off screen or behind a wall stays drawn, a far end in a chunk the client has not loaded, the F3+B boxes, and the box of the wire held in hand (HeldWireBounds).

EntityCulling runs its own block entity occlusion culling and may still hide a long wire while the connector block itself is occluded. If wires vanish behind occluders, add createaddition:connector, createaddition:small_light_connector, createaddition:large_connector and createaddition:redstone_relay to the blockEntityWhitelist of EntityCulling in config/entityculling.json and ship that file as an override, since the repository holds no EntityCulling config yet.
Shears on a connector with 4 wires drop 4 wire items in survival and nothing in creative mode, and each far end lets go of its wire.
A festive spool between two large connectors shows the red message that it requires a high current wire, and no wire is made.
The command /cca_wires refuses a player without op level 2. Over RCON it was tested in the Overworld, the Nether and the End only. Run stats in the Skylands and the Twilight Forest with execute in.

The planned chunk border test cannot be built on Forge 1.20.1: a ticking connector's neighbour is always in a chunk at full ticket level and getBlockEntity waits for it. Only the normal path (energy flows) was verified. Watch for a connector next to a machine whose capability is late after a restart of the live world copy.

WireGraphVerifier: isReadable() checks tag.contains("block_entities") and blockEntity() fetches the list again later. A concurrent put of __context that resizes the map could make the second lookup empty and markMissing a real node. All 83 full chunks of the full pack Arclight test world have exactly 20 top level keys, so the resize threshold of 24 is not crossed. Optional: take the ListTag once in SavedChunk or isReadable and reuse it, and only markMissing when the saved section block state at the position is not a CC&A wire node block.

AbstractConnectorBlockEntity: as in upstream 1.7.2, a wire end stays stale on B when its partner A was removed by a non player (drill, explosion or contraption) while B was unloaded and A dropped the wire. Breaking B before the graph prunes that end drops the wire a second time (playerWillDestroy and dropWires, or remove()). No practical exploit was found. Optional: prune the slots whose partner is in missing in onNodeLoaded, or skip the drop in remove() and dropWires for a slot whose far end the graph has confirmed gone.

The status row of cca-wiregraph on okf/modpack/createaddition-backport.md lists the integrated commits. Renumber the UPSTREAM.md Source changes items and the NOTICE summary if later bundles append items.

commits: 23822fc fix(createaddition): answer goggle observations only near the player
68f66f6 fix(createaddition): name Create's current code licence holder in the NOTICE
d52d46c feat(mods): bundle the Create Crafts & Additions fork 1.20.1-1.7.3-skytekx.1
f6cd870 chore(config): add the new Create Crafts & Additions keys to the common config
tests: Build: ./gradlew build at the fork state of 68f66f6 gave SHA-1 b7355fab1f431ddf186a5c7be2e5a4d4c751983b, 1716104 bytes, the same jar as the two release builds of 2026-11-05. No datagen applies, the fork has no data providers.

Compat: ccacompat.py against the 271 other jars of the full pack boot found 0 missing symbols. Only AllTheLeaks links into the mod, no jar declares a range on createaddition, no KubeJS script or config names it.

Savegame: a world built with 1.3.3 on Forge 47.4.18 with Create 6.0.8 and CC:Tweaked 1.120.2 loaded with the fork. All 29 recorded block entities kept every NBT key, the chest of 27 stacks stayed identical, the block states stayed identical except the new waterlogged=false of barbed wire, the graph took the 9 wire nodes in 5 networks and tools/wire_scan.py --compare found 0 differences. The new pump and servo worked, an empty capacitor of the fork stacked onto a 1.3.3 stack, and a second fork boot kept everything.

Full pack boots of f6cd870: createaddition-forge and createaddition-arclight reached Done with 0 FATAL lines, no crash report and no watchdog, and showed no new log signature against newmods-forge and newmods-arclight, the last boots with the same mixin export. The mixins of the fork were applied in the exported classes on both loaders.

Hook boots createaddition-forge-hook and createaddition-arclight-hook (Done only, then in world checks over RCON): Tesla Coils over depots made immersiveengineering:wire_electrum from a gold wire, createaddition:electrum_rod from a gold rod, thermal:electrum_ingot from a gold ingot and create:copper_tiles from weathered copper tiles, and charged a capacitor to 5000 FE. An Electric Pump between Create pipes ran, which applied FluidPropagatorMixin, and a servo took FE and followed a redstone signal. A chain of 320 connectors filled in one command formed one network, and after 14 of its 20 chunks unloaded, cca_wires rebuild walked the 224 unloaded nodes through the saved chunks back to 320 nodes in 1 network.
deferred: Login checks: a stock 1.3.3 pack client against the fork server and a fork client against a 1.3.3 server must end with 'Connection closed - mismatched mod channel list' naming createaddition:main, and a fork client must join the fork server.

Alternator scan gate: tools/alternator_scan.py <world> --json before.json on a copy of the live world with every dimension, a boot of the copy with the release jar, Chunky over the built area of each dimension, then --compare before.json. Fix every listed spot before the deploy.
Live world gate of the connector rework: every step of the first cca-wiregraph entry above, with skytekx-compat 2.1.6 and 2.1.3 on the production Arclight jar.
Client checks of the connector rework: every step of the second cca-wiregraph entry above, and the EntityCulling whitelist if long wires vanish.

In game tests of the small fixes: the 3x3x5 Modular Accumulator with goggles, its schematic print and a Symmetry Wand, barbed wire in water, with a wrench and picked up, the Electrum Block mined with an iron pickaxe, the goggle timers, the stress tooltips and the death messages on a client.

Portable Energy Interface on a train, a fix of the base (9c6dc1a, excluded as pei-capability-invalidate): after the train leaves and comes back, also after a station stop, the interface still moves FE, and the cable or pipe on the fixed side keeps no capability of the old contraption (PortableEnergyInterfaceBlockEntity:33-50).

Wire spool stacking, a fix of the base (42fe46d, excluded as wire-spool-stacking-fix): a spool used for a connection and empty again, and a spool whose connection was cancelled halfway, stack with fresh spools (WireSpool.java:89, 107).

Liquid Blaze Burner refuel from a container, a fix of the base (3ec4663, excluded as liquid-blaze-burner-fluid-container-rewrite): a bucket of bioethanol or seed oil and a filled Mekanism Portable Tank refuel the burner, and the empty bucket or the drained tank comes back to the player (LiquidBlazeBurnerBlockEntity.java:306-313).

In game tests of the changes of 1.6.0: the motor, alternator, shaft and alternator chain with Flywheel on and off, the Electrum Amulet with a player and amulet_effect_enabled false, a capacitor discharging into a machine, crafting with a charged capacitor, and its tooltip and bar.
Supplementaries' lumisene fire next to the ignitable fluids in game.

Electric Pump on a client: the goggle line, the partials with Flywheel on and with /flywheel backend off, the wrench reversal, the recipe in JEI and EMI, the item model, and an Electric Pump and a Mechanical Pump in series at 32 and 256 RPM in both orders with redstone toggles. Repeat the FluidPropagator export check after every Create update.

Charging on a client: a Sequenced Assembly charging step in JEI and in EMI, the synced recipes, a run on a moving belt, the coil drawing of ChargingAssemblySubCategory, the gold nugget and the JEI listing of the electrify recipes.

Servo Motor on a client: the wrench roll on all six faces, the four value boxes per roll, the renderer and the Flywheel visual, the 24 blockstate variants, the item model, the goggle line, a lever door rig, a printed schematic and a servo inside a contraption.
Ponders on a pack client: the pump, connector and servo scenes, the accumulator scene and Create's Fluid Tank scene with the whole mod set.

Optional code notes, not applied to keep the release jar stable: the ListTag of WireGraphVerifier, the stale wire end double drop, the shared clientTimeRemaining of TimeRemainingPacket, a debug line for the late answer guard of the verifier, and the pump hysteresis, which is an open owner decision.

Deploy: with the java process gone, remove mods/createaddition-1.20.1-1.3.3.jar from the server and copy local-mods/createaddition-1.20.1-1.7.3-skytekx.1.jar in, together with the next pack, since clients need the same jar.
